entities.name: Belaxis
entities.description: A half-compleated Phyrexian from the Hunter Maze of New Phyrexia, talkative and clever, used by Ixhel to form Vishgraz.

entities.name: Vishgraz
entities.description: Creature Ixhel formed from pieces of Belaxis, Geth and herself.

entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: A fully compleated Phyrexian warrior tasked by Atraxa with eliminating Geth.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A traitorous lich and one of the seven Steel Thanes of the Dross Pits.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: The Grand Unifier of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Drivnod
entities.description: Dominus of Pain whose spines Belaxis was impaled on.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: A perilous sphere of New Phyrexia with harsh conditions and deadly inhabitants.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: Part of New Phyrexia where Geth rules as a Steel Thane.

events.summary: Belaxis escapes the Hunter Maze and reaches the Dross Pits, making a deal with Geth for protection.
events.quote: He escaped the Maze and made his way to the Dross Pits

events.summary: Belaxis, gatekeeper of Geth's fortress, offers to help Ixhel solve the gate puzzle to survive.
events.quote: Belaxis offered to help Ixhel solve the gate puzzle

events.summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on Drivnod's spines and combines him with Geth and herself to create Vishgraz.
events.quote: she impaled Belaxis on the spines of Drivnod

relations.note: Atraxa tasked Ixhel to eliminate Geth.
relations.quote: tasked by Atraxa , the Grand Unifier, to eliminate Geth

relations.note: Formed from pieces of Belaxis, Geth and herself.
relations.quote: to create a creature she called Vishgraz

relations.note: Belaxis was gatekeeper of Geth's fortress under a protection deal.
relations.quote: Belaxis' role as a gatekeeper for Geth's fortress
